bagPolicy.summary: Bags 10x6x2 inches and smaller can go through expedited entry, while bags up to 14x14x6 inches must be screened by x-ray machines. Bag check is available at the P3 Lobby of the Garden Garage.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The Rose Quarter offers over 2500 parking spaces across four garages and two lots, with prices ranging from $10 to $40 depending on the event. Pre-paid parking is available for most events, and motorcycle parking costs the same as regular vehicles.

rideshare.note: Information on pick-up and drop-off locations for Moda Center are below.

concessions.note: Veterans Memorial Coliseum offers a variety of food and drink options including local favorites like 19 Acres Cider and Cha Cha Cha. Visitors can enjoy a range of offerings from BBQ and Mexican food to vegan and vegetarian options. Special highlights include the woman-owned Fusion Shave Ice stand.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Rose Quarter campus has four parking garages each with ADA accessible parking on most levels. Veterans Memorial Coliseum's dedicated ADA entrance, is located on P3 in the Garden Garage on the north end of the Moda Center.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Veterans Memorial Coliseum's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Rose Quarter Box Office at Moda Center and the Veterans Memorial Coliseum Box Office opens 2 hours prior to the event start time and is closed on non-event days.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Please note, both Information Booth phone lines will only be answered thirty minutes before DOORS open on event days. Note: Both phone lines will only be answered thirty minutes before doors open on SHOW DAYS.
